retrievalProfile.description: A narrative urban illustration style featuring stylized characters in a convertible car against a backdrop of industrial buildings and graffiti-tagged walls.
triggerTerms: stylized characters in a black convertible

recipe.visualDefinition: A painterly, comic-influenced scene depicting a group of figures in a classic black convertible driving through a stylized urban environment. The background includes industrial brick buildings, grassy embankments, and walls covered in colorful graffiti, all rendered with a slightly gritty, airbrushed texture.
coreVisualRelationships: figures in car as the primary focal point
coreInvariants: prominent black convertible with chrome accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The black convertible occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, spanning horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The figures inside the car, particularly the central figure, serve as the anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the car's horizontal line from left to right, then moves upward to the background buildings and typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with narrative and environmental details.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (car) and Green (grass) provide the base structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (clothing and car highlights) creates sharp contrast against the dark vehicle.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and Yellow (graffiti and typography) provide vibrant focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graffiti and sky contrasts with the deep, dark values of the car.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain deep blacks for the vehicle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Blocky, architectural letterforms with decorative extensions.
letterConstructionRules: Vertical bars extending into a frame-like structure
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters integrated into a continuous top horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine custom architectural lettering with a clean, slanted sans-serif for secondary information.

preserve: architectural frame structure of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: For the secondary slanted text to match the weight and presence.
To replicate the unique framed structure of the primary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly illustration of three men in a black convertible driving past a grassy hill with industrial buildings and graffiti-covered walls in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, custom block-letter title at the top with a red outline and a horizontal bar connecting the tops of the letters. Add a secondary slanted sans-serif title below it.

verificationChecks: Is the car the dominant horizontal element?
Does the typography have a custom, framed appearance?
Are the graffiti elements integrated into the background environment?

adjustableVariables: number of figures in the car
postGenerationChecks: Check for painterly texture across all surfaces.
Ensure the car's chrome and black paint have high-contrast highlights.
Verify the typography is legible but stylized.
Confirm the background elements do not distract from the main figures.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Narrative Illustration + [Subject in Vehicle] + [Industrial/Graffiti Background] + [Architectural Block Typography]
